summary: Mixed Martial Arts Group Ltd filed a Form 6-K furnishing unaudited interim financial statements for the six months ended December 31, 2025 and the year ended June 30, 2025. The filing details a return to a positive net asset position of A$3.26M, conversion of pre-funded warrants, and settlement of deferred consideration from the BJJLink acquisition. No transaction or special-situation event is announced; the filing is a routine financial update. No deal terms or strategic actions are present.
